sentence: This project develops methods that help robots understand and respond to safety concerns in homes, city streets, and hospitals.
This project extends coding and algorithm techniques to data made of many short, out-of-order fragments, such as DNA sequencing reads.
This project builds computational tools to study how slender structures, such as flowers and leaves, form their shapes.
This project builds a chip that delivers light into tissue so a microscope can image single cells at greater depth.
This project builds statistical models that combine network and functional data from multiple sources to study brain regions.
This project supports a program of workshops and a school on the mathematics behind quantum entanglement in many-body states.
This project uses laboratory instruments and computers to learn about molecules and materials with light of different wavelengths.
This project builds algorithms that combine deep learning with classical numerical schemes to solve hard scientific computing problems.
This project builds efficient methods to solve linear programs that have billions of constraints but only a small number of variables.
This project builds an infrastructure for mobile edge sensing and computing where research groups run practical experiments and share data.
This project builds an educational game platform that gives learners real-time feedback as they practice making decisions together.
This project hosts a workshop on how next-generation arithmetic and other tools can make supercomputers use less energy.
This project builds an AI system that monitors network conditions, detects anomalies in real time, and adapts network resources.
This project studies how pesticides react on aerosol particles in the air and where they land afterward.
This project builds simulation tools and control methods so robots can move and work more safely in space and underwater.
This project studies how a bacterial partner of the fruit fly defends it against parasitic wasps and nematodes.
